value.answer: Honestly the reviews split, so there's no single agreed winner. My pick is the 2026 Kia Carnival Hybrid. It gets 32 mpg combined, not far off the Sienna's 36, and it comes with a 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty, which the review I saw calls the best in the class. The Odyssey and Sienna are the other strong ones.
